notes.title: Updated lighting, changed part of the location and other changes
notes.notes:
Welcome players!
The lighting has been completely redesigned in the game.
Added more details. Part of the location has been changed.

Keys
Now you don't need to look for them. All the doors that were previously locked with a key are now open.

Flashlight
Now you don't need to look for batteries on the flashlight. It will shine endlessly.

Camera
There is also no need to look for batteries on the night vision camera. Now it will work indefinitely.

notes.title: New Year's Winter version
notes.notes:
Our small team VDGames wishes you a Happy New Year and Merry Christmas!
In honor of these holidays, we have replaced the regular version of the map with a winter one. The regular version will return to the game on January 15, 2022.

In the Winter Sale, according to the rules of Steam, we cannot participate because the game was released not so long ago, but still we decided to present you with a small gift in the form of game keys (see below). We kindly ask you to take 1 key in 1 hand.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
1. Fixed spawn of items for the ceremony: now they do not spawn a second time when loading if they are already in our inventory.
2. Removed the "Apply" button for items for the ceremony.
3. Added a note from the guard and a cassette that shows the appearance of the Doctor in the clinic. The cassette can be viewed using a VHS player and TV.
4. Added screamers.
5. Added a classic rocking chair.
6. Replaced some of the music.
7. Fixed a moment with music in the menu when it did not decrease when trying to decrease it in the audio settings.
8. Added subtitles to closed doors when trying to open them.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Minor corrections have been made to the game.

P.S. now you will not leave the clinic right away ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Some minor fixes has been made:
1. Objects draw distance has been increased.
2. You can easily find a ritual room now and you won't confuse it with similar room in the toilet.
3. Some text has been added.

If the game is too dark or too bright for you, you can always adjust the brightness in the menu.
